finding_key: packages/cli/src/docs/image-fetcher.ts::ssrf: `docs export` / `slides export` fetch arbitrary absolute urls taken from document content with no scheme or host restriction
evidence: Verified against the full text of packages/cli/src/docs/image-fetcher.ts: resolveImageUrl (line 28) passes through any scheme-prefixed URL untouched, and createImageFetcher (line ~53) fetches it with global fetch — no scheme allowlist, no loopback/link-local rejection, no redirect limit — echoing the resolved URL into the error (line 52). The URLs are image-inline `src` values from document content (confirmed by the file's docstring and by the export wiring in slides.ts/docs.ts in the diff), which is content other workspace members or agents can author, so an export fetches attacker-chosen URLs from the operator's machine and embeds the bytes into the PDF/DOCX. The behavior is pre-existing and untouched by this diff, as the claim itself states, but the described defect is present exactly as claimed.
